description: A prominent, straight, NNW–SSE trending linear ridge visible in the DTM hillshade, approximately 900 m in length and 3–5 m wide, exhibiting a slight convex cross‐section. Corresponding faint dark line in the NIR composite suggests moisture retention consistent with terra preta or canal sediments.

A shorter, obliquely oriented (NE–SW) linear depression about 400 m long and 2–3 m wide, with paired concave flanks and a subtle central berm, characteristic of secondary drainage canals feeding larger causeways.
